title: pipe_demolish_btn_center re-derives the pipe-anchor midpoint instead of delegating to the single-sourced rnd.pipe_anchor
detail: The N2-r4 fold single-sourced the anchor math, but the new test helper re-derives the same midpoint from fixture constants; drift is self-detecting (a desynced click fails the scenario loudly), and build_scenarios holds no topo to pass in — hence note, not warning.
recommended_fix: Optional: give the helper a fixture-spawned topo and call rnd.pipe_anchor(view, topo, 0); or keep the re-derivation and note it as a deliberate independence check.
